title: CLI Calculator
description: A small, reliable calculator with an explicit policy for invalid operations.
requirements: Read one expression as integer, operator, integer.
Print undefined for division by zero, or invalid for an unknown operator.
Keep calculation separate from stream input and output.
milestones: Handle invalid operations and verify all tests

title: Number Guessing Game
description: Give useful feedback, count attempts, and stop at the right moment.
requirements: Read a secret number and a sequence of guesses.
Respond low, high, or correct to each guess.
Stop processing after a correct guess.
Print attempts N, counting only processed guesses.
milestones: Read the secret and guess count
Stop on success and count attempts correctly

title: Simple Contact Manager
description: A command-based address book that handles lookup, replacement, and deletion.
requirements: Support add, get, and remove commands.
Adding an existing name replaces its number.
Keep contacts in memory for the duration of a run.
milestones: Store and update contacts by name
Implement lookup and removal, then verify edge cases

title: Text Statistics Tool
description: Make the rules of a text-analysis program precise and testable.
requirements: Read all input until the end of the stream.
Count ASCII letters and whitespace-delimited words.
Find the length of the longest word, including its punctuation.
Handle empty input and multiple lines.
milestones: Check whitespace, punctuation, and empty input
